# 00000001706

**English.** Definition: An S-adic system is generated by successive substitutions following a symbolic sequence; the frequency measure is the limit of symbol frequencies. Conjecture: There exists an S-adic system whose frequencies do not converge yet whose deviation is always a bounded integer (mild nonconvergence); the construction interleaves Fibonacci and Tribonacci substitutions.

**中文。** 定义：S-adic 系统指按符号序列逐步替换生成的系统;频率测度指符号出现频率的极限。猜想：存在 S-adic 系统,其频率不收敛但偏离始终为有界整数(温和非收敛);构造由 Fibonacci 与 Tribonacci 替换的交错给出。
